_comment: Conformance vectors of the rule interpreter (row 434 step 3): a rule, the events dispatched at its host element, and the decision it must reach. `bun test` (primitives/ts-test/rules.test.ts) runs them against the shipped bridge.js; `cargo test` (primitives/src/bridge/rules.rs) checks every rule deserializes into the Rust `Rule` enum and round-trips. scripts/check-bridge-rules.sh requires at least one vector per rule kind. `expect.attrs` are attributes the host must carry afterwards, `expect.messages` what Rust receives, `expect.prevented` per step whether the event was cancelled (omit when a rule never cancels).

vectors.name: fixture: sets the attribute and reports on every event
